label: Galaxy Z Fold5 foldable smartphone
description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold5 — book-style foldable that opens to a 7.6-inch tablet display, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6/mmWave, USB-C 3.2 with full DeX.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz + mmWave. Full Samsung DeX over USB-C 3.2 Gen 1, so a dock with GbE gives a real wired interface (usb0) while Wi-Fi stays up — the classic 'tablet on a dock' endpoint. Large folding chassis, 4.4 mm closed / 6.1 mm open, relevant to antenna efficiency modelling.
